decisions.evidence: Overall, the positive structural and exposure-related signals are outweighed by the countervailing properties, so the molecule is best classified as not causing a skin reaction.

Across all six neighbors, the positive-similarity neighbors 1 to 3 each end up favoring non-reactivity overall despite a few reactive-leaning features such as lower minimum absolute partial charge and, in some cases, higher logD or molecular weight. The negative-similarity neighbors 4 to 6 also end up favoring non-reactivity overall, even though they include some features that would otherwise support skin reaction. Because every neighbor comparison lands on the non-reactive side, the combined local evidence supports option (A): does not cause a skin reaction.
